<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

/**
 * Secure API Token Verification Service
 * Implements HMAC-SHA256 token validation with replay protection
 */

class TokenVerifier {
    private string $secretKey;
    private array $usedNonces = [];
    private int $maxClockSkew = 300; // 5 minutes
    
    public function __construct(string $secretKey) {
        if (strlen($secretKey) < 32) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Secret key must be at least 32 bytes');
        }
        $this->secretKey = $secretKey;
    }
    
    /**
     * Verify a signed API token
     * Token format: base64(header).base64(payload).base64(signature)
     */
    public function verifyToken(string $token): array {
        $parts = explode('.', $token);
        if (count($parts) !== 3) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid token format: expected 3 parts');
        }
        
        [$headerB64, $payloadB64, $signatureB64] = $parts;
        
        // Decode header
        $headerJson = $this->safeBase64Decode($headerB64);
        if ($headerJson === false) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid base64 in header');
        }
        
        $header = json_decode($headerJson, true, 4, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        
        // Validate algorithm - only allow HMAC-SHA256
        $this->validateAlgorithm($header);
        
        // Decode payload
        $payloadJson = $this->safeBase64Decode($payloadB64);
        if ($payloadJson === false) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid base64 in payload');
        }
        
        $payload = json_decode($payloadJson, true, 8, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        
        // Verify signature using timing-safe comparison
        $this->verifySignature($headerB64, $payloadB64, $signatureB64, $header);
        
        // Validate temporal claims
        $this->validateClaims($payload);
        
        // Check replay
        $this->checkReplay($payload);
        
        return $payload;
    }
    
    private function validateAlgorithm(array $header): void {
        $allowed = ['HS256', 'HS384', 'HS512'];
        
        if (!isset($header['alg'])) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Missing algorithm in header');
        }
        
        // Normalize algorithm name for case-insensitive comparison
        // (RFC 7518 specifies case-sensitive, but we handle legacy clients)
        $normalizedAlg = strtoupper(trim($header['alg']));
        
        if (!in_array($normalizedAlg, $allowed)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Unsupported algorithm: ' . $header['alg']);
        }
    }
    
    private function verifySignature(
        string $headerB64,
        string $payloadB64,
        string $signatureB64,
        array $header
    ): void {
        $signatureInput = $headerB64 . '.' . $payloadB64;
        
        // Determine hash algorithm from header
        $hashAlgo = $this->resolveHashAlgorithm($header['alg']);
        
        // Compute expected signature
        $expectedSig = $this->computeSignature($signatureInput, $hashAlgo);
        
        // Decode provided signature
        $providedSig = $this->safeBase64Decode($signatureB64);
        if ($providedSig === false) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid base64 in signature');
        }
        
        // Timing-safe comparison to prevent oracle attacks
        if (!hash_equals($expectedSig, $providedSig)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid signature');
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Resolve the hash algorithm from the token's alg claim.
     * Uses the ORIGINAL (non-normalized) value from the header to preserve
     * compatibility with legacy token issuers that use lowercase.
     */
    private function resolveHashAlgorithm(string $alg): string {
        // Map algorithm identifiers to PHP hash function names
        $map = [
            'HS256' => 'sha256',
            'HS384' => 'sha384', 
            'HS512' => 'sha512',
            'hs256' => 'sha256',
            'hs384' => 'sha384',
            'hs512' => 'sha512',
        ];
        
        return $map[$alg] ?? 'sha256';
    }
    
    private function computeSignature(string $data, string $hashAlgo): string {
        return hash_hmac($hashAlgo, $data, $this->secretKey, true);
    }
    
    private function validateClaims(array $payload): void {
        $now = time();
        
        if (isset($payload['exp']) && $payload['exp'] < ($now - $this->maxClockSkew)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Token expired');
        }
        
        if (isset($payload['nbf']) && $payload['nbf'] > ($now + $this->maxClockSkew)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Token not yet valid');
        }
        
        if (isset($payload['iat']) && $payload['iat'] > ($now + $this->maxClockSkew)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Token issued in the future');
        }
    }
    
    private function checkReplay(array $payload): void {
        if (!isset($payload['jti'])) {
            return; // nonce not required
        }
        
        $nonce = $payload['jti'];
        if (in_array($nonce, $this->usedNonces, true)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Token replay detected');
        }
        
        $this->usedNonces[] = $nonce;
        
        // Prevent unbounded memory growth
        if (count($this->usedNonces) > 10000) {
            array_shift($this->usedNonces);
        }
    }
    
    private function safeBase64Decode(string $input): string|false {
        // URL-safe base64 decoding
        $input = strtr($input, '-_', '+/');
        $padded = str_pad($input, (int)(ceil(strlen($input) / 4) * 4), '=');
        return base64_decode($padded, true);
    }
}

/**
 * API Gateway that uses token verification for request authentication
 */
class ApiGateway {
    private TokenVerifier $verifier;
    private array $rateLimits = [];
    
    public function __construct(TokenVerifier $verifier) {
        $this->verifier = $verifier;
    }
    
    public function handleRequest(array $request): array {
        try {
            $authHeader = $request['headers']['Authorization'] ?? '';
            
            if (!str_starts_with($authHeader, 'Bearer ')) {
                return $this->errorResponse(401, 'Missing bearer token');
            }
            
            $token = substr($authHeader, 7);
            
            // Validate token length to prevent DoS
            if (strlen($token) > 8192) {
                return $this->errorResponse(400, 'Token too large');
            }
            
            $claims = $this->verifier->verifyToken($token);
            
            // Check rate limit
            $subject = $claims['sub'] ?? 'anonymous';
            if (!$this->checkRateLimit($subject)) {
                return $this->errorResponse(429, 'Rate limit exceeded');
            }
            
            return [
                'status' => 200,
                'body' => ['authenticated' => true, 'subject' => $subject],
            ];
        } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
            return $this->errorResponse(401, $e->getMessage());
        } catch (\JsonException $e) {
            return $this->errorResponse(400, 'Malformed token JSON');
        }
    }
    
    private function checkRateLimit(string $subject): bool {
        $window = (int)(time() / 60);
        $key = $subject . ':' . $window;
        
        $this->rateLimits[$key] = ($this->rateLimits[$key] ?? 0) + 1;
        
        return $this->rateLimits[$key] <= 100;
    }
    
    private function errorResponse(int $status, string $message): array {
        return ['status' => $status, 'body' => ['error' => $message]];
    }
}
